brief:
The Al-Quds Brigades said a force operating alongside the Israeli army abducted and killed its member Fadi Ali Al-Abadla in Al-Qarara, north of Khan Younis, on Friday, according to IMEMC News. The armed group alleged that Israeli military drones provided support for the operation that resulted in the fighter's death.

The killing marks another incident in the ongoing Israeli military operations spanning the Gaza Strip. Al-Qarara, located in the northern section of Khan Younis, has been a site of repeated clashes between Palestinian armed groups and Israeli forces throughout the conflict.

title: Al-Quds Brigades says Israeli-backed force kills Gaza fighter
